root_cause: The PAT-less Supabase GitHub production authority observed a successful exact-SHA Supabase deployment check while social-recovery-runner remained on provider v7. Supabase GitHub Integration only deploys Edge Functions declared in supabase/config.toml; the social publisher and recovery runner were absent, so the deploy phase could be green without promoting them.
prevention_rule: Every authority-critical production Edge Function must be explicitly declared in supabase/config.toml with its provider-compatible verify_jwt mode and entrypoint. Regression tests must fail closed if either social authority function is missing or misconfigured. A green provider check alone is insufficient for TERMINAL_GREEN until provider source parity is verified.
